task.title: Fix governed promotion ENOTDIR failure on candidate .git directory check

scope.owned_layer: Governed supervisor promotion filesystem/Git identity capture for immutable candidates and bootstrap mutable incumbents, plus focused regression coverage.
not_changing: immutable candidate symlink or gitfile rejection
promotion scheduling, transaction states, rollback ordering, or deployment authority
live supervisor configuration or process state
supervisor fleet policy or canonical task-state governance

incident.observed_failure: ValueError: Candidate Git directory is a symlink or has the wrong type: [Errno 20] Not a directory: '.git'
incident.root_cause: The bootstrap mutable-incumbent capture called _open_candidate_root_handle(require_immutable_location=False). That parameter relaxed only the command-runtimes path restriction; the handle still required a standalone .git directory. Pantheon's mutable dev-root is a linked worktree whose .git is a regular gitfile, so the immutable-only O_DIRECTORY check failed before rollback materialization.
incident.misleading_label: The shared immutable handle labeled every root as Candidate Git directory, which made the failure appear to originate from the standalone 619acd candidate even though the incompatible layer was mutable-incumbent binding.

repair.strategy: Keep immutable candidate validation unchanged and introduce a separate read-only mutable Git binding for bootstrap incumbents.
controls: immutable candidates still require a direct command-runtimes/<sha> child with a local .git directory
mutable .git may be either a directory or a stable regular gitfile, but never a symlink, hard link, or other file type
the mutable root, .git control, referenced Git directory, and common directory are captured component-by-component with no-follow directory opens and revalidated after source capture
the gitfile has a bounded size, strict UTF-8 single-record format, and canonical non-padded target path
mutable Git discovery disables fsmonitor, untracked cache, hooks, optional locks, replacement objects, global config, and system config
the Git top level must equal the process cwd, the local config must not contain includes, and the single origin URL must validate as ajoe734/pantheon
HEAD/tree must match a fresh trusted origin/dev fetch before and after capture
index flags, staged drift, and tracked worktree drift fail closed; untracked runtime-only mutable files do not contaminate the freshly materialized rollback clone
all candidate identity descriptors are promoted above fd 0/1/2 before being exposed through /dev/fd to Git children

commands.result: exit 23; ValueError: Candidate Git directory is a symlink or has the wrong type: [Errno 20] Not a directory: '.git'

commands.conclusion: same real mutable worktree binds successfully without promotion

runtime_rollout.required_followup: After protected merge, a separately authorized operator may run the existing governed sync/promotion path and require a promoted transaction with fresh-loop evidence.

rollout_and_rollback.rollout: Merge through the task PR into dev. Do not run sync-dev-root, edit live config, signal the supervisor, or delete candidates in this source-repair task.
rollout_and_rollback.rollback: Revert the task PR if independent review finds the mutable gitfile binding too permissive or any existing promotion regression fails. The runtime remains untouched by this task.
rollout_and_rollback.fail_closed: Any mutable root/gitfile/Git-directory/common-directory identity drift, symlink, hard-linked gitfile, malformed gitfile, untrusted remote, external config include, unaccepted tree, staged change, tracked worktree change, or immutable candidate gitfile remains a hard failure.

notes: Confirm the immutable CandidateRootHandle still rejects both symlink and regular gitfile .git controls.
Review that the new gitfile path is reachable only from bootstrap mutable-incumbent capture.
Review no-follow component binding and the before/after revalidation of mutable root, Git directory, common directory, HEAD/tree, index, tracked tree, and governed sources.
Review that untracked mutable runtime debris is ignored only on the mutable source and is never accepted in an immutable candidate.
Bind this committed manifest with REVIEW_FILE when approving the exact PR head.
